analogies.text: Plan lock is like a blind analysis in physics: the analysis is fixed before the answer can be seen.
analogies.source: blind analysis practice in particle physics

analogies.text: Planted effects are like injection-recovery tests in astronomy: fake signals of known size are added to the data to check that the method finds them.
Multiple testing is like the look-elsewhere effect in physics: the more places one searches, the more likely a chance bump appears somewhere.
Negative controls are like null or calibration runs: analyses in which no real signal should appear, used to measure false alarms.
The bias budget is like a systematic-error budget in physics: each known source of bias is listed with its likely size.

designs.text: A prediction rule was fixed first and then scored on records that played no part in building it, so the score shows how the rule would do on new cases.

Genetic variants are inherited at conception, before any disease begins, so people who carry variants that raise an exposure form a natural experiment: if the exposure matters, those people should also differ in the outcome.
